# Forecast Evidence

The forecast is context for a bounded plan, not authority over greenhouse safety.

| Horizon | Condition | Planner response |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 12 hours | Mild | Hold targets |
| 24 hours | Warmer | Review ventilation |
| 48 hours | Stable | Preserve safety rails |
